title: SREV-038 api copy string from user

audit_contract.description: API: Api_CopyStringFromUser | data: {"input": "UNICODE_STRING64* from user mode", "output": "Driver_Pool-owned NUL-terminated WCHAR string plus byte length"} | callers: Sandboxie/core/drv/conf.c:Conf_Api_Update

validation_invariants.description: All contracts listed in the contracts metadata must hold before any data is trusted past the validation boundary

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate proves contracts hold under normal and malformed inputs

contracts: UNICODE_STRING64.Length is a byte count and must be aligned to sizeof(WCHAR)
nonzero Length requires a non-NULL Buffer
the copied string is locally NUL-terminated after the counted payload
embedded NUL in the counted payload is invalid before returning a C-string view
allocation failure returns STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES without modifying ownership
